Current repo mattfryed/massive, commit 27a3e7ce. Captures with scripted movement through real input, silent, not human play. New captures ORBITAL/DYNAMO/COSMOS/EMERGENCE from 15 October checkout. Existing visual studies and isolated footage use September / 6 October states and illustrate the visual system; they do not certify final event capture.
